variants.label: PULSE 01 / FLOW
variants.name: Pulse 01 — Flow
variants.description: Een breed, vloeiend woordmerk met open letters. De R gaat sterker op in de naam; de pixelstroom geeft het systeem beweging.
variants.logo: FLOW: redesign the logo as one fluent wide geometric italic wordmark. Use a custom compact parallel-channel R seamlessly followed by evive, broad oval e bowls with generous open counters, smooth geometric v joins, 12-degree forward lean, substantial but less chunky strokes than the source. Large white wordmark, including a WHITE first R, with only the square i dot in magenta. The integrated R must match letter height and weight and feel like part of a single typographic family. The separate icon uses the same R in magenta. This variant prioritises a coherent fluid word rather than colour-separating the first letter. First R still has its distinctive parallel interior channel and unmistakable diagonal lower-right leg.
variants.prompt:
Edit the supplied J1D / PULSE moodboard into a new complete logo study titled "PULSE 01 / FLOW", 1536x1024 landscape.
USER HAS CHOSEN PULSE. Preserve the black/white/magenta/cyan palette, rich dark moodboard, PIXEL/PARTICLE visual language, two sweeping channels and full brand applications. Main new request: DIFFERENT LOGO VARIATIONS. REMOVE ALL CAR/RACING CONTENT.
LOGO VARIANT: FLOW: redesign the logo as one fluent wide geometric italic wordmark. Use a custom compact parallel-channel R seamlessly followed by evive, broad oval e bowls with generous open counters, smooth geometric v joins, 12-degree forward lean, substantial but less chunky strokes than the source. Large white wordmark, including a WHITE first R, with only the square i dot in magenta. The integrated R must match letter height and weight and feel like part of a single typographic family. The separate icon uses the same R in magenta. This variant prioritises a coherent fluid word rather than colour-separating the first letter. First R still has its distinctive parallel interior channel and unmistakable diagonal lower-right leg.
WORD CONSTRUCTION is mandatory: custom first R followed immediately by evive, exactly SIX letters R-e-v-i-v-e. No extra r, no emblem placed beside a full revive. The first R is part of the word on same baseline and with ordinary letter spacing. Name revive only. Use identical custom R in every full wordmark, monochrome, reverse, small UI and standalone app icon. Show large hero wordmark, a clear smaller black/white test, a reverse test and isolated icon. All logo edges crisp and solid; pixel/particle background must never obscure letter readability.
PIXEL VISUAL LANGUAGE: retain the source's distinctive TWO broad sweeping magenta/cyan channels dissolving into fine square pixels and particles, set on near-black. Continuous strong leading edge fading into tiny pixel trails. Some visible small square pixels among the finer grain establish the digital feel. Forward-flowing asymmetric energy, confident momentum without automotive imagery. Show the original pixel-rich treatment in a large campaign, graphic-elements panel, desktop hero, app background detail and printed proposal; also one simple flat two-band counterpart. Do not replace the pixels with generic gradients, vague glow or smooth abstract blobs. The pixel aspect is essential.
REMOVE ALL car, wheel, racetrack, road, racing livery and speedometer imagery and metaphors. Replace the large car campaign with a compelling abstract pixel-stream composition on black with clear headline and plenty of negative space. Photography should be PEOPLE AND FINANCING: confident adviser and entrepreneur at a table, laptop and proposal documents; natural daylight, real business setting. Keep the human service photograph in lower panel. Website can use pixel hero and a human photo or commercial architectural detail, but no vehicles. Pixel motion conveys speed.
KEEP COMPLETE MOODBOARD content: large new logo, small mono/reverse/icon, lettering specimen, colour swatches, GT Eesti Display supporting type specimen, large campaign, pixel graphic language, coherent simple icon set, three-step financing process, human photo, desktop website, mobile app and proposal cover. Same grid/content density as source so variants are comparable. Flat typography/linework with premium realistic device/print mockups. Supporting text stays GT Eesti Display visual reference, independent of new logo font.
PALETTE unchanged and labelled accurately: Carbon #080A0D, Wit #F5F5F2, Magenta #ED28B9, Cyaan #40BED8.
TEXT CLEANUP is required: REMOVE the invented source copy "FINANCING MOMENTUM", "SNELLER VERDER SAMEN", and all other additional slogans/claims. Do not reproduce them anywhere, including footers and proposal covers.
ONLY TWO MARKETING LINES permitted, both exact and clearly readable:
"Financiering op het moment dat het telt."
"Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit."
First large in campaign, second in website/campaign. All other text only functional specimen labels, palette names/hexes or short UI labels: board title, "revive", "Logo", "Woordmerk", "Kleuren", "GT Eesti Display", "Light", "Regular", "Medium", "Bold", "Aa", "0123456789", "Grafische elementen", "Iconen", "Proces", "Aanvraag ontvangen", "In beoordeling", "Volgende stap", "Fotografie", "Website", "App", "Voorstel", "Je aanvraag", "Contactpersoon", "Bekijk aanvraag".

variants.label: PULSE 02 / GRID
variants.name: Pulse 02 — Grid
variants.description: Een modulair R-teken en hoekigere letters. De vierkante pixels komen ook terug in het logo, met een leesbare volle basisvorm.
variants.logo: GRID: redesign the first R from a precise coarse square-pixel grid but retain a robust, predominantly SOLID letter silhouette with closed R bowl and obvious diagonal lower-right leg. Two parallel stepped inner channels echo the source R. Limit exposed pixel stepping to clean edges and 2–3 square notches; no scattered dust inside the logo. A contemporary modular fintech logo, not a retro arcade font. The following evive uses a custom heavy squared geometric italic sans with rectangular e counters, clipped 45-degree corners, square i dot, 10-degree forward lean. Magenta first R, white evive. Matching stroke weight, baseline, visible body height and close normal letter spacing. Every letter clearly legible. This is the visibly modular, rectilinear alternative.

variants.label: PULSE 03 / SIGNAL
variants.name: Pulse 03 — Signal
variants.description: Een compacter R-teken met krachtige, smallere letters. Cyaan krijgt meer nadruk in het logo; de magenta pixelstroom blijft behouden.
variants.logo: SIGNAL: a distinctly compact, tall, bold neo-grotesk italic logo with semi-condensed evive, tall open e bowls and square i dot. Only 8-degree coherent forward lean. Redesign the custom first R as a narrower readable R letter: two thick parallel contours around a tightly controlled bowl, one short clear diagonal lower-right leg. Less exaggerated race-emblem width; it is convincingly the first letter of the name. Cyan first R + white evive. Match body height, baseline and dense stroke weight. Tight optical letter spacing. This variant is shorter and more compact than both the source and Flow, strong in a financial application header and at small size.
